body: Merged main through the stack (#516 → #517 → #518 → #468); it merges cleanly now. #516's one conflict was in `ChangeOperationKind`: main's per-setup `family_gate` and this stack's `thread_gate` are both kept. The threading, lathe-post, conformance, posting and project_roundtrip suites pass on each branch, as do all camcraft-post tests; clippy is clean. Still a draft until a lathe run.

Merged #518's refreshed branch to resolve conflicts. It carries #516's rebuild on #629's chuck-ward ladder, plus #517 and #518, plus main.

**`turning/thread.rs`:** #629's ladder is unchanged. The per-pass dip rows sit on top of it. The dips-need-the-record refusal moved into `thread_dips::require_record()`, text unchanged, to keep the file near 400 lines.

**Dip geometry on the -Z travel:** dips are laid by half-turn index from the pass's entry at the free end. The first and last whole leads, the phase law, the 45° law and the never-deeper rule all carry over, mirrored in Z.

**Stream and post:**
- `cnc_thread` writes `... PULLOUT .. HAND .. [ALT 1] [REP 1] [DIP 1]`.
- The engine, js and mod keep both the `threadHands` refusal and the `continuousThreading` refusal.
- In `fanuc-lathe.cps`, the hand check runs on every half-turn before the dip logic.

**New pin:** `dips_keep_the_hand_and_the_chuck_ward_travel` (right and left hand).

**Golden changed:** `thread_g32_dips.nc` changed by direction only. Each pass now enters at Z24 and runs to Z8, and the dips sit at Z19, Z15 and Z11 instead of Z13, Z17 and Z21, with the same X and lead. Every other golden is byte-identical to the parent.

**Gate:**
- motion: lib 163, `turning_thread` 18, `turning_thread_cycle` 3, `turning_thread_dips` 9, `turning_thread_infeed` 10.
- post: all.
- app: lib 103, `conformance` 6, `golden_cl` 23, `inverted_post` 15, `lathe_post` 7, `lathe_post_g76` 8, `lathe_post_g76_schedule` 5, `lathe_post_refusals` 5, `lathe_post_thread_dips` 6, `posting` 17, `project_roundtrip` 71, `turning_thread` 9, `turning_thread_infeed` 5.
- ui: `thread_hand_tests` 1.
- clippy `-D warnings` on post and motion (all targets) and the app lib: clean.
- **Known failure:** `lathe_thread_travel`'s stale fixture, from main (#686).

Still a draft for a lathe run. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main to resolve conflicts (merged #518's refreshed branch, which carries main with #712; crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs: keep both sides). Targeted gate: app lathe_thread_travel 2, lathe_post_g76 8, lathe_post_g76_schedule 5, lathe_post_thread_dips pass; clippy -D warnings clean on camcraft-app. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check). Stays a draft.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (stacked on #518: merged its refreshed branch; crates/motion/src/turning/mod.rs, thread.rs: kept both sides). One non-trivial hunk: main moved thread_warnings into thread_law.rs (#904) while this PR added the chip-break dip verdict (`thread_dips::dip_warnings`) to the old copy; the dip verdict is now appended in thread_law's thread_warnings_excess, so the check is kept (not dropped) and covers the _excess twin too. Targeted gate: motion turning_thread_dips 3 (+cycle 9, infeed 10); app lathe_post_thread_dips 6, lathe_post_g76 8, lathe_post_g76_schedule 5, turning_thread 9, turning_thread_infeed 5, inverted_post 15, lathe_field_tools 2, lathe_thread_travel 2 pass; clippy -D warnings clean (motion lib+tests, app, ui lib). Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/post/src/post/mod.rs: keep both sides, ChipBreakDips and SurfaceSpeed records; stack 516/517/518 already contained). Added the new struct fields main's tests need (infeed_plan in coarse_laws, lathe_post_css, tormach_lathe_support; ThreadCycle fields in post recorded_streams). Targeted gate: lathe_post_thread_dips 6, lathe_post_g76 8, g76_schedule 5, turning_thread_infeed 5, lathe_post_css 10, lathe_post_tormach 7, motion turning_thread_dips 9, camcraft-post suites all pass; clippy app/motion/post/ui clean. coarse_laws has 4 failures that are main's own stale wording (test says 'larger budget', src says 'larger STEP facet budget'; not this PR; #1176/#1180 fix it). Ready for a re-check.

Merge-time refresh of this branch against main was attempted and stopped; nothing was pushed, the branch is unchanged (head d5066016).

The merge itself resolves cleanly by the keep-both rules (5 conflicted files: `crates/app/src/commands/operation/create.rs` and `edit.rs` gate calls and imports, `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` manifest flags `continuous_threading` + `wire_edm`, `crates/post/tests/inverted_post.rs` thread record fields, `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` manifest list). It builds, and the post, motion and most app thread suites pass.

It stopped because one of this PR's own pinning tests fails, and it fails on the current head before main is merged in as well, so it is not caused by the merge:

- `crates/app/tests/turning_thread_infeed.rs::the_plan_rides_the_project_file_and_a_default_one_is_absent`, line 231: `TH1: the loaded cache matches its plan` - left `Stale`, right `Ok`. After save and load, `stale_reason` for TH1 reads "operation 'TH0' ahead of it in the program changed - regenerate the program in order" (rest digest, `crates/app/src/rest.rs` `prior_stale`). The plan round-trips equal; TH0 (default plan, created first) loads Ok, but TH1 (non-default plan, chained behind TH0) loads Stale.

Author: please look at why the predecessor's contribution to TH1's rest digest differs after a save/load round trip (or whether the test's two-op fixture should not chain), fix it, then re-run the refresh.

Follow-up on the earlier refresh stop: the failing test `turning_thread_infeed.rs::the_plan_rides_the_project_file_and_a_default_one_is_absent` was not this PR's fault. It was a defect on main (issue 1351: a second dependent threading operation read Stale after save and load, because the path signature hashed bit-exact values while the project file snaps them to its lattice). PR 1352 fixed it on main (merge commit 0ad525d8). After the next merge of main the test should pass. This PR changes the Passes tab; before/after screenshots in the description help the maintainer merge UI changes.

Taken for the refresh (SKULL, mkinney fork agent): merging main into #516 -> #517 and #518 -> #468, bottom-up, now that #1351/#1352 is on main. Other sessions: please leave this PR alone until SKULL's follow-up comment.

Refreshed on main (author side, not a review) - ready for review of this refresh, but **left DRAFT: main moved again during the run and now conflicts** (see the end).

Head `e16f68f3` (merges on `d5066016`):
1. `67ce4b5f` - merge of #518's refreshed head (`dc962cc9`, which carries upstream/main `36035af8`).
2. `0b4a26d3` - merge of #518's `872cc40d` (its test-only default fields at main's new literals).
3. `e16f68f3` - merge of #518's final head `5e9909cc` (the refreshed #517 parent). A follow-up `git merge upstream/main` was already up to date.

**Conflicts and resolutions (keep both sides)**
- `crates/post/src/post/js.rs`: main's `wire_edm` manifest flag (#533) and this PR's `continuous_threading` flag (#419) are both kept: field, default and manifest read, each its own statement.
- `crates/post/tests/inverted_post.rs` (moved to `crates/post/tests` on main): the parents' `alternating`/`repeat_each_depth` and `camcraft_post` paths, plus this PR's `chip_break_dips`.
- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`: main's `serves` (#1266) key and this PR's `continuousThreading` are both listed ("all but `serves` and the last seven"). This is not a process file, so there is no PROCESS_VERSION bump.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs`: #518's new `alternating`/`repeat_each_depth` lines duplicated the ones this branch already set at that literal (after `hand`, with `chip_break_dips`). Ours are kept and the duplicates dropped (merge 2).
- Merge 3 was clean. It brings #517's PathPilot G76 finishing-step fix (`548a4ad2`) through #518, which this stack needs once main's #612 Tormach lathe post is in (see #518's comment).
- `git diff upstream/main --stat`: only this PR's and its parents' files (#516, #517, #518).

**Posted output:** nothing changes from the merges. This PR's `fanuc-lathe/thread_g32_dips.nc` and the parents' `thread_g76.nc` / `thread_g76_area.nc` are byte-identical to the previous heads, and main's goldens are untouched (checked against `36035af8`).

**Tests (final head, no edits during the run)**
- `turning_thread_infeed::the_plan_rides_the_project_file_and_a_default_one_is_absent` passes (main's #1352).
- app `turning_thread*`, all `lathe_*` (incl. `lathe_post_thread_dips`, `lathe_post_g76_schedule`, `lathe_post_tormach_thread`), `tormach_lathes`, `golden_cl`, `operations`, `project_roundtrip`; post `lathe_post_refusals`, `script_fanuc_lathe`, `script_tormach_lathe`; motion `turning_thread*` (incl. `turning_thread_dips`) + lib `turning`; ui lib `thread`: all green.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: `crates/cl` is touched, so quick falls back to **batch**. Steps 01-06 (geometry, cl, tools, post, sim, motion) were green. Steps 07-09 (app suites, ui suites, clippy `-D warnings` on all eight crates) were run with the batch plan's exact commands, because the full batch does not fit the 30-min cap: all green.

Screenshots of the Passes tab (before/after) are in the description. 

**Still conflicting with today's main (`4c229ed3`), so not flagged ready.** This refresh is on `36035af8`. While the gates ran, main took about 80 more commits, including #977/#902 (Fanuc Lathe writes inch programs) and #1357. A trial merge now conflicts in:
- `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps` header: main adds `programUnits = "mm inch";` where this PR adds `continuousThreading = true;` with its citation. That half is mechanical (keep both).
- `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps`, the G32 pass writer: main changed the plain G32 block to `block(["G32", zWord(p.Z), "F" + fl(lead)])` (the lead now formatted in the document's unit). This PR rewrote that function into the continuous chip-break chain (`chainOn`/`chainTip`, the dip refusals, `G32 X Z F` segments) and still uses `"F" + fr(lead)`. **Both sides changed the same posted-G-code logic.** Resolving it means carrying main's inch lead formatting into every G32 word of the dip chain, and the dip refusals and `thread_g32_dips.nc` must hold in inch as well. I stopped there rather than guess (`git merge --abort`; nothing pushed past `e16f68f3`).
- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`: the manifest list again (mechanical).

#516, #517 and #518 still report MERGEABLE.

SKULL: parked. Main conflicts in 5 files: fanuc-lathe.cps G32 writer (main's inch lead fl() vs this PR's dip chain fr()), post engine.rs and js.rs, thread_dto.rs and posts/AGENTS.md. This is posted G-code logic changed on both sides, so it needs a careful hand merge and a full gate. It goes after the threading chain #517 → #518 lands.
